rules: failure_code is a bounded closed report-failure category only; free-form exception text, stack traces, paths and source payloads are forbidden
the worker/orchestrator durably assigns one UUID command_id to this exact failure transition before first invocation and reuses it on every retry
COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 request_hash binds report_attempt_id, expected_attempt_revision and failure_code

exact committed replay is resolved before current state/revision checks so a crash after the failed commit returns the original ReportAttemptV1 without repeating staging cleanup, revision advancement or audit
the request carries no filesystem cleanup target; any temporary candidate identity is derived only from persisted attempt/job state and the already-validated destination context
